about: An account as v0.1.104 kept it, built through its code paths, every table and key holding a producer's id: its library, clips and every row of theirs, each value as Postgres's text with its column's type, in an order to insert them; and what the API, the queue and the scheduler's due lists said of it then (tests/test_named_data_acceptance.py's rename test).
